title: Trace candidate generation before the final duplicate decision
description: Switch paths to see how normalization, compact signatures, an index, and exact verification divide responsibility. Candidate generation is allowed to be approximate; the product decision is not.

nodes.label: Document pair
nodes.detail: Provides the two objects to compare plus stable IDs, source metadata, and any domain-specific fields needed for a final decision.

nodes.label: Feature contract
nodes.detail: Applies the same versioned tokenization, case folding, boilerplate removal, shingling, and feature weighting to indexed objects and queries.

nodes.label: SimHash
nodes.detail: Projects weighted features into a fixed-width bit fingerprint. Nearby fingerprints are retrieved by Hamming-neighborhood indexing, not an all-pairs scan.

nodes.label: MinHash
nodes.detail: Stores minimum values from independent hash functions. Signature agreement estimates Jaccard similarity between the feature sets.

nodes.label: Candidate index
nodes.detail: Uses Hamming buckets or MinHash LSH bands to retrieve a bounded candidate set. Its job is to preserve useful recall while limiting verification work.

nodes.label: Exact verifier
nodes.detail: Loads the original features, computes the declared exact metric, applies business rules, and records the decision with model and feature versions.

scenarios.label: MinHash candidate
scenarios.summary: Two documents use the same feature contract, collide in at least one configured LSH band, and reach exact Jaccard verification.
scenarios.result: The verifier computes Jaccard similarity from the original shingle sets and applies the labeled threshold. The MinHash collision proposed the pair; it did not decide the outcome.

scenarios.label: SimHash candidate
scenarios.summary: Weighted feature vectors produce fingerprints inside the indexed Hamming search radius.
scenarios.result: The Hamming index avoids an all-pairs comparison. The verifier still checks the original evidence because fingerprint proximity can include unrelated objects.

scenarios.label: False-positive candidate
scenarios.summary: A pair collides in a MinHash band even though its exact Jaccard score is below the duplicate threshold.
scenarios.result: The exact verifier rejects the pair. This is expected candidate-stage work, not a product false positive, as long as approximate matches cannot bypass verification.

scenarios.label: Feature-version drift
scenarios.summary: Indexed documents and new queries use different normalization or shingling rules.
scenarios.result: A true neighbor can miss every candidate bucket and never reach verification. Version the feature contract, rebuild or dual-read the index, and measure recall on labeled pairs before promotion.
